seeds.name: Wheat Seeds
seeds.desc: Plant them in a dirt plot, then keep them watered.

carrot-seeds.name: Carrot Seeds
carrot-seeds.desc: Carrots grow fast. Plant them in a dirt plot.

pumpkin-seeds.name: Pumpkin Seeds
pumpkin-seeds.desc: Pumpkins take a long time to grow, but they are worth it.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Harvested from the farm. The farmer pays for it. Eat it to heal a heart.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.desc: Crunchy. Sells at the market. Eat it to heal a heart.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.desc: A big pumpkin. Sells for a good price. Eat it to heal two hearts.

herb.name: Herb
herb.desc: A fragrant wild herb. Useful for brewing, one day.

wood.name: Wood
wood.desc: Chopped from trees. Sell it or use it to repair an axe.

stone.name: Stone
stone.desc: Broken out of rocks. Repairs pickaxes.

lantern.name: Heartwood Lantern
lantern.desc: A gift from the treant. It never needs oil. Lights the way into dark caves.

crest-stone.name: Crest Stone
crest-stone.desc: Carved with a ninja crest. Granite guarded it for the cave builders. It fits the stone door.

crystal.name: Glow Crystal
crystal.desc: A softly glowing crystal. Moths love it.

crystal-lantern.name: Crystal Lantern
crystal-lantern.desc: The Bat Queen's lantern. It shines much brighter than yours, and it may reveal hidden things.

frostberry.name: Frostberry
frostberry.desc: A chilly blue berry. Snow foxes love them.

frost-boots.name: Frost Boots
frost-boots.desc: Fur-lined boots that grip thin ice. You can walk across the frozen lake in them.

seaweed.name: Seaweed
seaweed.desc: Slippery and salty. Crabs love it.

moon-crest-half.name: Moon Crest (half)
moon-crest-half.desc: Half of a silver crest. The princess carries the other half... or did.

sunstone.name: Sunstone
sunstone.desc: A warm golden stone. Armor smiths in the bazaar prize them.

cactus-fruit.name: Cactus Fruit
cactus-fruit.desc: Sweet and prickly. Sand lizards love it.

moon-crest-half-2.name: Moon Crest (other half)
moon-crest-half-2.desc: The other half of the silver crest. Join it with the first half.

moon-crest.name: Moon Crest
moon-crest.desc: The whole silver crest, glowing softly. It seems to point north.

frostberry-seeds.name: Frostberry Seeds
frostberry-seeds.desc: Plant them in a dirt plot on the farm. They grow into a treat for your friends.

seaweed-seeds.name: Kelp Spores
seaweed-seeds.desc: Plant them in a dirt plot on the farm. They grow into a treat for your friends.

cactus-fruit-seeds.name: Cactus Seeds
cactus-fruit-seeds.desc: Plant them in a dirt plot on the farm. They grow into a treat for your friends.

waystone-charm.name: Waystone Charm
waystone-charm.desc: A charm that hums near waystones. Open the bag and press Space to travel to any waystone you have lit.

bread.name: Bread
bread.desc: Warm, fresh bread. Eat it to heal.

carrot-stew.name: Carrot Stew
carrot-stew.desc: A hearty stew. Eat it to heal.

pumpkin-soup.name: Pumpkin Soup
pumpkin-soup.desc: Smooth and sweet. Eat it to heal.

frost-pie.name: Frost Pie
frost-pie.desc: A cold, tart pie. Eat it to heal.

sea-roll.name: Sea Roll
sea-roll.desc: Salty and chewy. Eat it to heal.

cactus-salad.name: Cactus Salad
cactus-salad.desc: Crisp and juicy. Eat it to heal.

ninja-feast.name: Ninja Feast
ninja-feast.desc: A feast from every land. Eat it to heal a lot.

healing-potion.name: Healing Potion
healing-potion.desc: A red potion. Drink it to heal.

greater-potion.name: Greater Potion
greater-potion.desc: A strong potion. Drink it to heal a lot.

elixir.name: Elixir
elixir.desc: A golden elixir. Drink it to heal fully.

acceptance-letter.name: Acceptance Letter
acceptance-letter.desc: Your letter from the Ninja School. Proof that you have earned your place.

padded-vest.name: Padded Vest
padded-vest.desc: Pet armor. Your friend gets tired later when it wears this. Fit it at the Pet Dojo.

copper-mail.name: Copper Pet Mail
copper-mail.desc: Pet armor. A big boost to a friend's stamina. Fit it at the Pet Dojo.

crystal-plate.name: Crystal Plate
crystal-plate.desc: The best pet armor. Lots of stamina and a little extra bite. Fit it at the Pet Dojo.

ember-gem.name: Ember Gem
ember-gem.desc: An enchantment for your weapon: +1 damage. Set it at the Enchanting Workshop.

greater-ember-gem.name: Greater Ember Gem
greater-ember-gem.desc: A strong enchantment for your weapon: +2 damage. Set it at the Enchanting Workshop.

ward-gem.name: Ward Gem
ward-gem.desc: An enchantment for your armor: +1 defense. Set it at the Enchanting Workshop.

greater-ward-gem.name: Greater Ward Gem
greater-ward-gem.desc: A strong enchantment for your armor: +2 defense. Set it at the Enchanting Workshop.

swift-scroll.name: Swift Scroll
swift-scroll.desc: An enchantment for your weapon: swings 25% faster. Set it at the Enchanting Workshop.

moonbloom-seeds.name: Moonbloom Seeds
moonbloom-seeds.desc: Plant in a farm plot. It only grows at night. A treat for owls and moon hares.

glowcap-seeds.name: Glowcap Spores
glowcap-seeds.desc: Plant in a farm plot. It only grows at night. A treat for fireflies.

moonbloom.name: Moonbloom
moonbloom.desc: A pale flower that only blooms at night. Owls and moon hares love it.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.desc: A glowing mushroom that only grows at night. Fireflies love it.

fishing-rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing-rod.desc: Face a pond and press Space to cast. Press Space again when the fish bites!

pond-minnow.name: Pond Minnow
pond-minnow.desc: Tiny and quick. Good in a stew. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

sunfish.name: Garden Sunfish
sunfish.desc: Round and golden. It likes the sun. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

moon-carp.name: Moon Carp
moon-carp.desc: A pale carp that only wakes at night. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

golden-koi.name: Golden Koi
golden-koi.desc: A rare koi. Shiny as a coin. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

forest-trout.name: Forest Trout
forest-trout.desc: A speckled trout from the forest pond. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

mossy-bass.name: Mossy Bass
mossy-bass.desc: Green as the moss on the rocks. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

glow-eel.name: Glow Eel
glow-eel.desc: It glows softly in the dark water. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

silver-salmon.name: Silver Salmon
silver-salmon.desc: A rare, strong fish. It fights hard! Cook it at the Fish Grill.

frost-perch.name: Frost Perch
frost-perch.desc: A chilly little fish from under the ice. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

icicle-pike.name: Icicle Pike
icicle-pike.desc: Long and sharp, like an icicle. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

aurora-char.name: Aurora Char
aurora-char.desc: Its scales shimmer like the northern lights. Cook it at the Fish Grill.

soggy-boot.name: Soggy Boot
soggy-boot.desc: Someone lost this. It smells awful.

fish-stew.name: Fish Stew
fish-stew.desc: Warm and savoury. Eat it to heal.

sunfish-fry.name: Sunfish Fry
sunfish-fry.desc: Crispy and golden. Eat it to heal.

grilled-trout.name: Grilled Trout
grilled-trout.desc: Smoky and juicy. Eat it to heal.

bass-bake.name: Bass Bake
bass-bake.desc: Baked with carrots. Eat it to heal.

moon-curry.name: Moon Curry
moon-curry.desc: Spicy, with a moonlit glow. Eat it to heal.

eel-soup.name: Glow Eel Soup
eel-soup.desc: It really does glow. Eat it to heal.

frosty-skewer.name: Frosty Skewer
frosty-skewer.desc: Fish and berries on a stick. Eat it to heal.

koi-feast.name: Koi Feast
koi-feast.desc: A fancy feast. Eat it to heal a lot.

aurora-sushi.name: Aurora Sushi
aurora-sushi.desc: Shimmering sushi. Eat it to heal a lot.

swift-brew.name: Swift Brew
swift-brew.desc: Fizzy green brew. Drink it to run faster for 45 seconds.

owl-brew.name: Owl-Eye Brew
owl-brew.desc: Glowing yellow brew. Drink it to see in the dark for 90 seconds.

shadow-brew.name: Shadow Brew
shadow-brew.desc: Swirly purple brew. Run faster AND see in the dark. A ninja favourite.

axe.desc: Chops trees. Wears out with use.

pickaxe.desc: Breaks rocks and boulders. Wears out with use.
